newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pakistan tenders to buy Oct-Dec oil products.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan tenders to buy Oct-Dec oil products.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources has issued a tender to buy 420,000 tonnes of diesel, 790,000 tonnes of fuel oil and 50,000 tonnes of gasoline for October-December deliveries, a ministry official said on Tuesday.
The tender closes on September 2 and offers will be valid until September 12, he said.
He said out of the total requirements of 1.0 percent sulphur diesel, 360,000 tonnes are sought on a fixed basis, while 60,000 tonnes are on an optional basis.
Out of the 790,000-tonne fuel oil demand, 290,000 tonnes will be on an optional basis.
One out of two 25,000-tonne cargoes of 83-octane leaded gasoline tendered are required on an optional basis, he said.
In its last tender for the third quarter, Pakistan purchased 180,000 tonnes of diesel on a fixed basis, and another 120,000 tonnes on an optional basis.
Pakistan also took one optional cargo of gasoline and one fixed cargo in the third quarter, while it sought 170,000 tonnes of fuel oil on a fixed and another 170,000 tonnes on an optional basis.
